name: 15 Minutes sand glass sandglass hourglass timer clock decor gift
description:
Type: Hourglass Sand Timer

Material: Durable high-quality plastic, glass, and sand with protective cover

Size: 4.4 × 9.8 cm

Colors: As shown in pictures

Package Contents: 6 × Hourglass timers (15 minutes)

Features:

Elegant and durable design, suitable as a gift for children or friends

Time management tool: visually track time for homework, reading, play, brushing teeth, or cooking

Printed, bold, clear time markings on each timer for easy identification

Portable: compact size, easy to carry in a pocket or backpack

Safe & durable: designed to withstand minor drops

Uses: Classroom, home, office, psychological training, cooking, and time control exercises

Notes:

Not a precision timing device; small deviations in timing may occur

Colors may slightly differ due to lighting or screen display

Measurement tolerance: ±1–3 cm

This set of colorful mini hourglass sand timers is both functional and decorative. Perfect for children to manage tasks, track time, or as a fun visual aid. Its sturdy design and compact size make it ideal for classrooms, homes, offices, or as a unique gift.
